citations.assessment: The Yerushalmi bathhouse story has Batris bar Yatsas. The separate Heilprin entry reads Batrim son of Yatsas. Preserve the rare forms of this entry, recording the alternate spellings.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
